items.q: Eddy Barefield, I ran into -- he was doing this too.

ctx.x: Yeah. We used to gad around together.
Well, he wasn't doing anything then except this. He was trying to -- he was doing the same thing. All those guys pretty much -- and Eddy Barefield, I ran into -- he was doing this too.
